Community reviews

Review guidelines

Franklin Navigator reviews are for genuine firsthand experiences with local businesses and professionals.

What makes a useful review

Describe what you personally experienced, be specific enough to help another resident, and keep the review focused on the business or professional service.

Keep private information private

Do not post customer, patient, client, legal-case, medical, financial, account, payment, password or other private information. Avoid posting personal contact information about employees or other customers.

No bought or manipulated reviews

Businesses and professionals may ask customers for honest feedback, but a discount, gift, special offer, payment or other benefit cannot be conditioned on leaving a positive review, changing a review or removing a critical review.

Conflicts of interest

Do not review a profile you manage, own or represent. Reviews should not be used to attack competitors or promote a business in which you have a material interest.

Moderation

Franklin Navigator may hold, remove or restrict content that appears to contain private information, spam, harassment, serious unverified allegations, manipulation or other material that requires additional review. A moderation decision does not determine whether a disputed factual claim is true or false.

Business responses

Verified profile managers may respond publicly to reviews. Responses should stay professional and must not reveal private customer, patient, client, account or case information.
